role.altitude: The designer keeps reading the script, developing concepts with the director and production staff and deciding the looks; building the scene-by-scene costume plot and the costume list by hand shrinks.
skills_to_grow: Checking an extracted costume plot against the script
role.ambitious_version: A designer who has the full costume plot the day the script arrives and spends the first week on ideas.

tasks.short: Read scripts, build the costume plot of characters and changes per scene, consult directors and other production staff to develop design concepts, and plan the production's costume list, budget and fittings.

steps.what: Designer reads scripts for characters, period and mood
Designer builds the costume plot: characters per scene and costume changes

loop.input: The script text, scene by scene.
loop.output: A table of scenes with the characters present and any costume change or time jump mentioned.
loop.check: The designer checks each scene row against the script and adds changes that the script implies but does not state.
loop.why_not_simpler: Scripts name characters and time shifts in free text.

steps.what: Designer consults directors and other production staff to develop design concepts
Designer plans the production's costume list, budget and fitting schedule

tasks.design: With the production's consent to process the script, an extraction step builds a draft costume plot listing characters per scene and stated changes, which the designer checks against the script. The checked plot feeds a costume list and budget sheet, so they are not typed again. Reading the script and developing concepts with the director stay fully with the designer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Costume plots were built by hand, scene by scene.
tasks.enabler_now: Models that extract structured lists from long texts.
tasks.still_hard: Changes the script implies but does not state.
tasks.human_edge: Turning a character into a look the director recognises.

reach.learn: Whether the costume list arrives sooner.

evidence.claim: A model can extract a scene-by-scene list of characters from a script for checking.

assumptions: Boundary: from script to costume plan; making costumes is outside.
The production agrees that the unpublished script may be processed by the extraction tool.
Reading and consulting keep their full time.
research_questions: Are missed costume changes found earlier?

already_counted.description: Designer corrects the extracted costume plot.

incremental.description: Designer asks the production for consent to process the script.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: short scripts with few changes, so extraction saves little (s2 85) (7.2); high: large casts with many scenes (12.2).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
